lines: Thus effortless spoken; effort-born but is described: seed-syllable-natured all, of consciousness vibration-nature.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ityayatnajamākhyātaṃ yatnajaṃ tu nigadyate bījapiṇḍātmakaṃ sarvaṃ saṃvidaḥ spandanātmatām
